description: Completion of the construction works of the Universities of Jaffna, Kelaniya, Colombo and Wayamba
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-12-10 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body:
- Constructions have been carried out through a number of projects to provide the buildings and other infrastructure facilities required for the State Universities on the recommendations of the Department of National Planning and with the approval of the Cabinet of Ministers and the said buildings and facilities are already being used for the academic activities of the University students. However, construction works related to several projects implemented with the approval of the Cabinet for the Universities of Jaffna, Kelaniya, Colombo and Wayamba have not been completed within the stipulated time. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Hon. Prime Minister in her capacity as the Minister of Education, Higher Education and Vocational Education to complete the construction works and to revise the total cost estimates as proposed for the same as follows, was approved by the Cabinet.



 
Name of the project
Procedure to be followed




01.
Construction and completion of the 4th and 5th floors of the building for the Siddha Medicine Unit, University of Jaffna.
To have carried out by selected contractors following the due procurement method.


02.
Construction of the Engineering Technology and Bio System Technology building, Phase II at the Kilinochchi premises of the University of Jaffna.


03.
Construction of the proposed Lecture Theater Complex in the Faculty of Science, University of Kelaniya.
To have completed through the original contractors by paying only the original contract price and price variations.


04.
Completion of the balance work of the proposed 17 storied building complex of the Faculty of Medicine, University of Colombo.
To manage the funds required to complete the remaining work within the provisions allocated under Expenditure Head of the Ministry of Education, Higher Education and Vocational Education during the years 2025 and 2026.


05.
Construction of the proposed building for the Information Communication Technology Centre of the Wayamba University of Sri Lanka
To have completed through the original contractors by paying only the original contract price and price variations.
